title: Waste of money.
text: Waste of money.. Very poor quality. One of the utensils was pulling away from the handle when I received them. Since then all the utensils have had the same issue. The glue used to hold the silicone to the handle is minimal and truly poor quality. Unfortunately none of these are even worth keeping. Waste of money. Very disappointed as I had high hopes for this set.
